_doc: Positive prompts must rank their own skill top-1. Negatives must rank NO skill above the floor. Prompts are written in the vocabulary a user would actually say, NOT by echoing the description back — a fixture that reuses the description's own words tests string matching, not routing.

blast: what breaks if I change this function
who calls this endpoint before I edit it
impact of renaming a shared class
brainstorming: I want to add a new feature, where do we start
lets design the approach before coding
dispatching-agents: can we split this across several agents
run these tasks concurrently without collisions
executing-plans: work through the implementation plan we wrote
keep progress on disk so we survive compaction
implement the plan task by task
finishing-a-branch: gates are green, how do we integrate this
the work is done, what now
gate: run the gate ladder and show exit codes
orchestrating: drive the multi task plan through the ledger
resume the fan out after compaction
pressure-testing: does this rule actually change behaviour
should we keep this instruction in CLAUDE.md
requesting-review: get an adversarial review before the PR
have someone try to refute these findings
review this before opening a pull request
systematic-debugging: this test fails and I dont know why
find the root cause of this bug
test-driven-development: prove the test fails for the right reason
using-worktrees: run two agents without stepping on each other
verified-autonomy: why did the stop hook refuse to end my turn
writing-plans: turn this approved spec into tasks
break the design into dispatchable units

negatives: what is the weather in Lisbon today
who won the world cup in 1998
recommend a pasta recipe for tonight
what is my current account balance
